dialogues.speaker: Maintenance Log
dialogues.text: "All I can do now is to try to stop the cooling system and try to seal the leaking areas. It's just a stopgap measure, however."

dialogues.speaker: Maintenance Log
dialogues.text: "If someone did remove the seals and operate the cooling system, the whole room would be instantly filled with a huge amount of water. The Forging Press will be utterly ruined."

dialogues.speaker: Maintenance Log
dialogues.text: "Though no one other than Bravais really cares about the devices in here, I suppose a prayer that the <color=#00E1FFFF>emergency drain</color> proves useful couldn't hurt."
